subject.title: feat(feeds): refresh and manage followed publishers

question: Should OpenClaw core own signed publisher-feed following, SQLite persistence, Gateway RPCs, and a recurring refresh scheduler, or should this service-specific lifecycle ship as a plugin or ClawHub integration?
rationale: This PR introduces a new persistent network-trust and control-plane surface rather than repairing an established behavior; repository policy requires owner-boundary and product judgment before accepting such work.

options.title: Keep the feature plugin-owned
options.body: Expose only any demonstrably missing generic core seam, then package publisher-feed trust, scheduling, and lifecycle commands outside core.

options.title: Sponsor a core control plane
options.body: Confirm that this is a supported core capability and require documented trust, storage, protocol, configuration, and upgrade commitments before the branch proceeds.

recommendation.title: Keep the feature plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Expose only any demonstrably missing generic core seam, then package publisher-feed trust, scheduling, and lifecycle commands outside core.

likelyOwner.reason: Only the feature proposer is identifiable from the available context; a source-history owner could not be established.
